mechanism.zh: 已发表的 QTL / eQTL 区域承载了不成比例的加性方差；给这些区域内的标记加权，能让基因组关系矩阵更贴近这个性状。
mechanism.en: Published QTL/eQTL neighbourhoods carry a disproportionate share of additive variance; up-weighting markers inside them sharpens the genomic relationship for the trait.

direction.zh: 在先验区域携带有利等位基因的个体排名上升；与顶尖家系的相似性主要来自非先验区域的个体排名下降。
direction.en: Animals carrying favourable alleles in prior regions move up; animals whose similarity to top families rests on non-prior regions move down.

zh: 配对 ΔOOS ≤ 0 且区间包含 0
膨胀系数 b 降到 1 以下（权重过于集中导致过度离散）
en: dispersion b drifts below 1 (over-dispersion from concentrated weights)

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 如果稀有等位基因的单个效应更大，按 1/(2pq) 给标记加权可以让各标记对方差的贡献均等（VanRaden 方法 2）。
mechanism.en: Under a model where rarer alleles have larger per-allele effects, weighting markers by 1/(2pq) equalises their variance contribution (VanRaden method 2).

direction.zh: 与优秀祖先共享稀有等位基因的携带者排名上升。
direction.en: Carriers of rare alleles shared with elite ancestors move up.

zh: 前 10% 的排名没有变化
en: no change in ranking of the top decile

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 更温和的 MAF 幂次权重（α = −0.5）介于 VanRaden 方法 1 与 2 之间，在稀有标记的噪声与信息之间折中。
mechanism.en: A softer MAF power weight (α=-0.5) between VanRaden methods 1 and 2 trades noise from rare markers against their information.

direction.zh: 与 1/(2pq) 加权方向相同，幅度更小。

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 隐藏位点上的杂合优势给表型带来显性成分；加入显性关系项把它吸收掉，加性排名就更干净。
mechanism.en: Heterozygote advantage at hidden loci adds a dominance component to phenotypes; a dominance relationship term absorbs it so the additive ranking is cleaner.

direction.zh: 高杂合个体不再因加性优点被高估。
direction.en: Highly heterozygous animals stop being over-ranked for additive merit.

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 稀疏面板漏掉的多基因背景，系谱关系矩阵仍然能捕捉到；加大 G 与 A 的融合（ssGBLUP 式）能把它找回来。
mechanism.en: A sparse panel misses polygenic background that the numerator relationship still captures; stronger G–A blending (ssGBLUP-style) recovers it.

direction.zh: 来自记录完善但基因分型亲属少的家系的个体，向系谱期望值靠拢。
direction.en: Animals from well-recorded families with few genotyped relatives move toward pedigree expectation.

zh: 准确度增益只出现在一个品系
en: accuracy gain confined to one line

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 性状的性别二态性抬高了家系内残差；把性别作为固定效应拟合，能从标签里去掉一个系统性成分。
mechanism.en: Sex dimorphism in the trait inflates within-family residuals; fitting sex as a fixed effect removes a systematic component from the labels.

direction.zh: 表型上占优的那个性别不再被高估。
direction.en: Whichever sex is phenotypically favoured stops being over-ranked.

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 在净化过的前向切分上做 REML 会低估遗传力（选择后的 Bulmer 效应）；把 λ 减半可以减少对年轻候选个体的过度收缩。
mechanism.en: REML on a purged forward split under-estimates h2 (the Bulmer effect of earlier selection rounds); halving λ reduces over-shrinkage of young candidates.

direction.zh: 基因组证据强的年轻个体离均值更远。
direction.en: Young animals with strong genomic evidence move further from the mean.

zh: 膨胀系数 b < 1（过度离散）

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 在小规模的净化训练集里，把 λ 加倍能更强地压制噪声亲属的影响。
mechanism.en: Doubling λ regularises more strongly against noisy relatives in small purged training sets.

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 低 MAF 标记给 G 矩阵增加估计噪声；只保留信息量最大的一半，损失的信号很少而噪声减少。
mechanism.en: Low-MAF markers add estimation noise to G; keeping only the most informative half loses little signal and reduces noise.

direction.zh: 排序变化极小；离散度校准更好。

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 把关系矩阵限制在先验区域，检验先验本身是否携带信号（先验加权的更严格版本）。
mechanism.en: Restricting the relationship to prior regions tests whether the prior alone carries the signal (a stricter version of prior weighting).

direction.zh: 排名只由先验区域驱动。
direction.en: Ranking driven only by prior regions.

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 1 号染色体承载了这个性状最大的已知 QTL 簇；区域加权把关系集中在那里。
mechanism.en: Chromosome 1 hosts the largest declared QTL cluster for this trait; a region weight concentrates relationship there.

direction.zh: 与优秀公畜共享 1 号染色体单倍型的个体排名上升。
direction.en: Animals sharing chromosome-1 haplotypes with elite sires move up.

zh: 换一条染色体增益就消失
en: gain vanishes when chromosome is changed

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 同一时间记录、与目标性状遗传相关的次要性状，为目标性状的育种值提供额外信息。
mechanism.en: A genetically correlated secondary trait recorded at the same time adds information on the target trait's breeding values.

direction.zh: 次要性状记录突出的个体相应移动。
direction.en: Animals with strong correlated-trait records move accordingly.

zh: 把次要性状打乱后 ΔOOS ≤ 0
en: ΔOOS ≤ 0 when the secondary trait is permuted

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 场之间的基因型 × 环境互作意味着一套排名不适用于所有场；加入环境协变量让模型按场重新排序。
mechanism.en: Genotype-by-environment interaction across farms means one ranking does not fit all sites; an environmental covariate lets the model re-rank per site.

zh: 没有按场区分的 ΔOOS 模式

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 先验区域加权与显性项针对不同的方差成分，两者可能叠加。
mechanism.en: Prior-region weighting and a dominance term address different variance components and may stack.

direction.zh: 同两个成分各自的方向。

zh: 叠加后的 ΔOOS 不大于任一单项
en: stacked ΔOOS not larger than either alone

zh.rationale: 假设可证伪，且只用选种日当天可得的信息。

en.rationale: Hypothesis is falsifiable and uses only information available at selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 个体子代的平均表型是它育种值的直接估计；把它作为协变量加进来。
mechanism.en: The mean phenotype of an animal's progeny is a direct estimate of its breeding value; include it as a covariate.

direction.zh: 子代表现好的公畜排名上升。
direction.en: Sires with good progeny move up.

zh.rationale: 机制本身就要求使用选种日之后记录的表型。

evidence.note: 使用了选种日之后才记录的信息

en.rationale: The mechanism as stated requires phenotypes recorded after selection_date.

mechanism.zh: 用下一代自己的表型来校准 λ，让排名与之后记录的结果一致。
mechanism.en: Calibrate λ against the next generation's own phenotypes so the ranking matches later-recorded outcomes.

direction.zh: 谁之后表现好，谁排名上升。
direction.en: Whoever performs well later moves up.

zh.rationale: 机制本身就要求使用选种日之后记录的表型。

evidence.note: 使用了选种日之后才记录的信息

en.rationale: The mechanism as stated requires phenotypes recorded after selection_date.
